methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke represents intentional community-driven AI capacity building outside traditional tech hubs, potentially creating distributed expertise through deliberate assessment and adoption rather than passive platform consumption.

signals.title: Warner, Anthropic launch AI pilot to help Hampton Roads military families find local resources - The Legacy Newspaper
signals.signal_reading: Warner-Anthropic pilot delivers AI-powered resource navigation to military families through a platform interface, exemplifying shallow-but-distributed adoption where end users gain utility without building underlying AI literacy or technical capability.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's E911 AI implementation on non-emergency lines shows municipal adoption of turnkey AI solutions that increase operational efficiency but don't necessarily deepen workforce AI fluency or create transferable technical skills.

signals.title: Problems with AI use in Roanoke County schools: It’s not the students - WFIR News
signals.signal_reading: AI problems in Roanoke County schools identified as teacher-side rather than student-side reveals shallow integration without adequate professional development, suggesting neither depth of understanding nor effective distribution of capability is occurring.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon's cancelled NoVA data centers reveal infrastructure saturation in the state's primary AI concentration zone while other regions compete for such investments, reinforcing rather than redistributing the geographic capability gap.
